name: io.github.Venly/settlement-mcp
title: Venly Finance MCP
description: Stablecoin settlement MCP for AI agents. Reads real data with credentials; writes are mock-only.

environmentVariables.name: VENLY_ENV
environmentVariables.description: mock (default: no credentials, no network, writes run in the sandbox), staging or production (read tools only)

environmentVariables.name: VENLY_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Venly Finance OAuth client id, needed for reads outside mock mode

environmentVariables.name: VENLY_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Venly Finance OAuth client secret, needed for reads outside mock mode
